title: Spatify · Service health
description: Is every part of Spatify up, how fast does it answer, and how often does it fail?

panels.title: gateway
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the REST gateway, the only way into Spatify. ▼ DOWN within about 5 seconds of it stopping.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: 1 if Prometheus's last scrape of gateway worked, else 0
up{job="gateway"}

panels.title: model server
panels.description: Whether the model server answers the gateway's /ping, checked every 15 seconds (a blackbox probe). Down during a version switch.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: the gateway's last /ping of the model server (1 = it answered)
spatify_model_server_up

panels.title: frontend
panels.description: Whether the web app's metrics can be scraped.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: 1 if Prometheus's last scrape of frontend worked, else 0
up{job="frontend"}

panels.title: pipeline worker
panels.description: Whether the pipeline worker is running.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: 1 if Prometheus's last scrape of worker worked, else 0
up{job="worker"}

panels.title: MLflow
panels.description: Whether the MLflow tracking server and registry are up.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: 1 if Prometheus's last scrape of mlflow worked, else 0
up{job="mlflow"}

panels.title: feedback store
panels.description: Whether postgres-exporter can query the Postgres database that holds lists, likes, skips and pipeline runs.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: 1 if postgres-exporter's last query of Postgres worked
pg_up

panels.title: requests per second - by listener endpoint
panels.description: Requests the gateway handles each second for the three endpoints listeners use, averaged over a minute. The simulator drives all three.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: requests per second per listener endpoint, from the recording rule over spatify_gateway_requests_total
spatify:gateway_requests:rate1m{endpoint=~"/recommend|/feedback|/tracks/search"}

panels.title: /recommend latency - p50, p95, p99
panels.description: Time to answer POST /recommend: half of requests are faster than p50, 95% faster than p95. The dashed line is the 300 ms alert on p95 (the problem statement's latency target). Estimated from histogram buckets.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: the median /recommend time over 1 minute, interpolated inside its histogram bucket
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(spatify_gateway_request_seconds_bucket{endpoint="/recommend"}[1m])))

# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: the 95th-percentile /recommend time (recording rule)
spatify:recommend_latency_seconds:p95_1m

# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: the 99th-percentile /recommend time over 1 minute
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(spatify_gateway_request_seconds_bucket{endpoint="/recommend"}[1m])))

panels.title: share of requests failing (5xx)
panels.description: The share of all gateway requests answered with a server error over 5 minutes, e.g. 503 while the model server switches versions. The dashed line is the 5% alert.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: 5xx answers / all answers over 5 minutes (recording rule)
spatify:gateway_error_ratio:rate5m

panels.title: model server - time to answer, p50 and p95
panels.description: How long the model server takes to answer the gateway's /invocations calls, measured by the gateway. Most of /recommend's time is here.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: the median model-server call time over 1 minute
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(spatify_model_server_request_seconds_bucket[1m])))

# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: the 95th-percentile model-server call time over 1 minute
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(spatify_model_server_request_seconds_bucket[1m])))

panels.title: model server - failed calls per minute
panels.description: Calls from the gateway to the model server that failed: unreachable (down or switching), http error (it answered 5xx), or rejected (a query it can't answer, e.g. an unknown seed song: the listener's mistake, not a fault).

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: failed calls per minute by kind, with every http_<code> folded into one 'http error'
sum by (kind) (label_replace(rate(spatify_model_server_errors_total[5m]), "kind", "http error", "kind", "http_.*")) * 60

panels.title: feedback store - query time p95, by operation
panels.description: How long the gateway's Postgres queries take: saving each served list, saving each like or skip, and looking a list up when feedback arrives.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: the 95th-percentile query time per operation over 5 minutes
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation) (rate(spatify_feedback_store_seconds_bucket{operation=~"save_recommendation|save_feedback|get_recommendation"}[5m])))

panels.title: MLflow - requests per second, by status class
panels.description: Requests to the MLflow tracking server and registry: from the gateway (champion, versions, rollback), the model server (the champion alias every 10 s) and the pipeline. 4xx is often normal (a lookup of something that doesn't exist yet).

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: MLflow requests per second, grouped by the first digit of the HTTP status (2xx, 4xx, 5xx)
sum by (class) (label_replace(rate(mlflow_http_request_total[1m]), "class", "${1}xx", "status", "(.).."))

panels.title: frontend → gateway calls per second, by outcome
panels.description: Every call the web app makes to the gateway: ok, an HTTP error, or unreachable (the gateway is down). Listeners see a friendly message for the last two.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: frontend-to-gateway calls per second by outcome, with every http_<code> folded into one 'http error'
sum by (outcome) (label_replace(rate(spatify_frontend_gateway_calls_total[1m]), "outcome", "http error", "outcome", "http_.*"))

panels.title: pages viewed and errors shown, per minute
panels.description: How much the web app is used, and how often it had to show a listener an error message instead of what they asked for.

targets.expr:
# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: page views per minute, all pages
sum(rate(spatify_frontend_page_views_total[5m])) * 60

# AI-generated PromQL (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code, 2026-11-15). Computes: error messages shown per minute, all kinds
sum(rate(spatify_frontend_errors_shown_total[5m])) * 60
